rationale: For an enterprise HR analytics application targeting top management, the UI must feel expensive, authoritative, and data-rich. We are using a deep slate/midnight blue dark theme to communicate premium quality (QlikView-like), completely avoiding generic fintech teal/mint or purple. Amber and Royal Blue will serve as elegant, high-contrast accents.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense but breathable. 1px borders. No soft shadows.

motion.charts: Recharts animated active dot and tooltip transitions

components.buttons: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all
components.cards: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-md shadow-sm overflow-hidden
components.charts: Use Recharts. Hide default axes grids entirely or use very subtle stroke-opacity 0.1 stroke='#1E293B'
components.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-950 border-r border-slate-800 flex-shrink-0 h-screen sticky top-0

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight depending on context

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: use Slate (900/950) for backgrounds and Blue/Amber for accents. No Teal/Mint/Purple.
Data components (tables, lists) must use the Control Room Grid pattern with gap-4 or gap-6 and dense layout.
All interactive elements (buttons, nav, charts, inputs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='sidebar-nav-turnover'`).
Replace standard Inter with Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Implement Shadcn UI for inputs, dialogues, dropdowns, and tabs, heavily customized to match the dark theme.
Use Recharts for all visualizations. Tooltips must be dark with 1px border. Hide axis grids or make them extremely faint (stroke-opacity 0.1).
